name: Team with security review, role skills and blind QA
description: The security-review team with role skills, where QA keeps the real tests from Dev: Dev builds from the requirement and only learns which behaviours fail, so the tests check Dev's work independently instead of steering it.

steps.name: Security reviewer
steps.purpose: Scans the code with Semgrep and audits it by hand for misuse and data leaks, and sends it back to Dev if something is risky.
produces: .devcrew/security.md: a verdict and security findings by severity

steps.name: Reviewer
steps.purpose: Checks the code against every sentence of the requirement and sends it back to Dev once if something is missing.
produces: .devcrew/review.md: a verdict and findings by severity
